_comment: First-party git dependencies built into the wheelhouse. pip's VCS syntax accepts ONE ref, so pyproject.toml pins the TAG and this file pins the tag object AND the peeled commit; packaging/tools/build_git_wheels.py clones the tag, fails unless HEAD == commit, and builds from the clean clone. The pins follow pyproject.toml of the converged trunk (origin/main's tags: runtime-contracts v0.3.14, discovery-runtime v0.1.19, knowledge-frontier v0.2.0); the RC line's earlier pins (runtime-contracts v0.3.4, knowledge-frontier v0.1.0) are superseded, see packaging/PINS.md.

dependencies.name: runtime-contracts
dependencies.note: v0.3.14 is the first tag without the stale committed build/lib that earlier tags ship (checked 2026-11-06: no committed build/ or dist/ in the tag's tree).

dependencies.name: discovery-runtime
dependencies.note: Added by the converged trunk: origin/main depends on it (pyproject pins v0.1.19, which requires runtime-contracts v0.3.14). Licence status of this component is not decided here.

dependencies.name: knowledge-frontier
dependencies.note: Pinned by tag v0.2.0 as origin/main pins it. Agent `licences` may exclude it from the shipped set; this pin is not a decision to ship it. Its licence is inferred (D-LIC-14 stays OPEN).

dependencies.name: redevops-connectors
dependencies.note: Replaces the floating @main of the frozen build. v0.1.0 is the exact commit the frozen CI run cloned; main has since moved (15 commits as of 2026-11-04).
